claims.subject: Casalino 2019 electric drive sizing
claims.object: one combined electric-drive-plus-pump power density on maximum electrical power; no separate motor or inverter values
claims.statement: Casalino 2019 sizes the electric drive system plus pump together, m_ep = P_e,max/delta_ep, with P_e,max the maximum electrical power required; its densities 1.25 (Set A) and 3.92 (Set B) kW/kg therefore include the pump and are on electrical-input basis, and the paper gives no separate motor or inverter density or efficiency.
claims.quote: is the maximum electrical power required

claims.subject: Casalino 2019 Set A overall efficiency
claims.object: 0.64 in the text (PDF p.5) and 0.68 in Table 1 (PDF p.6)
claims.statement: Casalino 2019 gives the Set A overall efficiency eta_ep as 0.64 in the text (PDF p.5) but 0.68 in Table 1 (PDF p.6); Set B is 0.53 in both places. The paper does not resolve the difference.
claims.quote: we assume two values for the overall efficiency

claims.subject: Casalino 2019 electrical property sets
claims.object: Set A: authors' 2010 HP/PE hybrid engine study [20]; Set B: most recent literature [19]
claims.statement: Set A electrical properties were already used by the authors in 2010 for a hydrogen-peroxide/polyethylene hybrid rocket engine [20]; Set B is taken from the most recent literature available [19].

claims.subject: Casalino 2019 overall efficiency eta_ep
claims.object: conversion of electrical energy stored in the batteries into flow head rise

claims.quote: into flow head rise is taken into account by the overall efficiency
